notes.title: Sona-Nyl of the Violet Shadows - Refrain Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2656690/SonaNyl_of_the_Violet_Shadows_Refrain/][img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017084/205ab3719b3abbf8107a05aea9949d7912d37935.png[/img][/url]

Explore the warped ruins of a steampunk New York City in this dramatic tale of mystery, discovery, and loss. 

The fifth entry in Liarsoft's Steampunk Series is a mysterious fairy-tale in which fantasy and reality intertwine. The story unfolds from the perspectives of two women: one who travels through the ruins of Engine City New York, destroyed in an unexplained disaster some years before; and one who finds herself in an underground world with a purple sky, where the "vanished" city still stands.

The central focus of the tale is Lily, a girl devoid of memories who sets off through the bizarrely transformed "Underground New York." Driven by her determination to reach the "ends of the sky," she travels through this dangerous world accompanied by an enigmatic young man known as A. In the course of her long and difficult journey, they meet many of the city's inhabitants, and fend off the attacks of strange and terrifying monsters.

What lies at the end of the road Lily travels? How is she connected to the woman exploring the ruins on the surface? And why was New York destroyed? In the course of their journeys, many mysteries will be unraveled...

For more information on Sona-nyl of the Violet Shadows, as well as other titles from MangaGamer, be sure to join the discussion on [url=https://discord.gg/5vbgyU6vxG]Discord[/url] or follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/MangaGamer]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/MangaGamerOfficial/]Facebook[/url].

notes.title: The Heart-Wrenching Tale of Android Love is Here With Minori's Trinoline!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/965010/Trinoline_All_Ages_Version/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017084/c44f9b179fed404c7652a2c39230830861f0e7de.jpg[/img][/url]

From minori, the creators of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/315810/eden/]eden*[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/496350/Supipara__Chapter_1_Spring_Has_Come/]Supipara[/url], and ef - a fairy tale of the two, comes a brand-new heart-wrenching, sci-fi tale of an everlasting android faced with the mortality of mankind.

When tragedy leads to the advancement of science and the development of a sentient android indistinguishable from humans, what does it mean to be human or android? Is it possible for man to love machine, or machine to love man? Is such a love even real or nothing more than a series of numbers? Can there ever be a future where such love may flourish, or is it destined for heartache?

Find out in Trinoline, available now on Steam! Order your copy today and be one of the first to enjoy this gorgeous, emotional tale!

notes.title: Gahkthun of the Golden Lightning Available Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Gahkthun of the Golden Lightning is now available on Steam![/h1]

The story of Gahkthun is an exciting tale of steam-punk fiction, which follows Nikola Tesla in a 19th century world drawing on the Lovecraft mythos. Armed with his electrical inventions and keen intellect, Tesla infiltrates an academy city, The Academia, in pursuit of secret society that is using the students to develop and test fearsome new technological powers. Written by Sakurai Hikaru, author of Fate/Prototype, Gakkougurashi, Game of Laplace, and Fate/Extella, Gahkthun holds countless mysteries to uncover within its action and intrigue.


To learn more visit our website at:
http://mangagamer.org/gahkthun/

Help spread the word on twitter with #Gahkthun and introduce everyone to the hottest new steam-punk title on Steam!
